answer: Each agent must burn a small ember of stake and sign its epoch pledge with a unique quill key anchored to a hardware-rooted identity, so every new identity costs real capital plus a verifiable device attestation. Sybil adversaries minting thousands of fake agents must fund each stake, acquire each device, and survive challenge audits; forging one anchor voids the whole cluster's quill signatures. Cheap identities become expensive, and honest peers can trace any ember back to its bonded origin. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
